mapper.select: SELECT l.liked_id, COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE l.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, l.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.publisher FROM lib_liked l INNER JOIN lib_books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and l.userid = #{userid} order by l.liked_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_liked l inner join lib_books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and userid = #{userid}
